Raced three wide without cover throughout.  Near the 350m was bumped on the hindquarters by Must Be Sain which in turn was bumped and taken out by Superliv

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped fairly. Rolled fwd before raced 3rd Four Wide (2.5L from lead) early . Held Ground midrace & pushed to quicken 3 Wide @ 500m. Struggling to hold ground @ 400m & gave ground Four Wide from home turn. Eased in last 200m. Vetted clear. # Beaten on turn
